item.title: Department of Corrections, Arkansas State Police fight contraband entering state prisons in two incidents

item.title: Arkansas Sen. John Boozman puts name on bipartisan legislation to support preterm birth reduction
item.description: The PREEMIE Reauthorization Act, signed into law by President Trump, extends funding through 2030 to reduce preterm births and infant mortality rates, and provides grants to help physicians and the public better understand risk factors for premature birth.
